Title: Active Ransomware Staging on Finance File Server
Description: EDR reported mass file encryption activity on \\srv-fin-02\shares. Suspicious executable running from AppData. Host isolated immediately; active user session terminated. Forensics ongoing.

Title: Brute Force Attack Against Domain Controller
Description: SIEM triggered high-frequency Kerberos pre-auth failures from IP 192.168.40.12. Source IP temporarily rate-limited; account lockout threshold reached for 4 service accounts.

Title: Phishing Credential Harvesting Link Clicked
Description: User in marketing clicked external link mimicking corporate SSO page. Credentials entered, but token reuse prevented by MFA prompt. Password forced-reset and session revoked.

Title: Unauthorized Port Scan from External Partner IP
Description: External scan detected targeting perimeter firewall ports 80/443 from known partner subnet. Verified against approved maintenance window schedule; benign activity confirmed and ticket closed.

Title: Cobalt Strike Beacon Outbound C2 Connection
Description: EDR flagged suspicious HTTPS beaconing to known threat intel IOC (IP 185.220.101.5). Host isolated via network containment policy. Memory dump captured for tier-3 analysis.

Title: Suspicious PowerShell Execution by Local Service Account
Description: Local service account executed obfuscated PowerShell command string invoking Invoke-Expression. Investigating script origin and parent process tree; execution blocked by AMSI.

Title: Outdated SSL/TLS Cipher Suite Detected on Edge Proxy
Description: Vulnerability scanner identified TLS 1.0 support on legacy web proxy. Notified infrastructure team to schedule cipher deprecation during upcoming change window.
